name: Carpet
desc: A patterned woven carpet running away to the vanishing point — cusped medallions, a boteh lattice and guard borders over a deep madder ground, the pile leaning so a drifting light sweeps broad bright and dark bands across the weave and the middle is walked flat; a Persian rug, a deco geometric, a flat-woven kilim, a threadbare runner worn to the jute, or a cyan setting-out plan.

energy.doc: master amplitude — how brightly the drifting light bands sweep the pile, and the scroll rate

scale.doc: motif tile size in world units — min a fine repeating field, max huge medallions

density.doc: loose fibres / lint drifting low over the pile

speed.doc: how fast the carpet streams toward the viewer

wear.doc: traffic — how much the pile is crushed and matted down the middle, and (threadbare) worn to the backing

hue.doc: ground field hue (madder red by default)

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: richly-knotted Persian rug / a deco geometric field / a flat-woven kilim with matte weave / a threadbare runner worn to the jute backing / a cyan setting-out plan, the motifs as pure line

seed.doc: knot lottery — the hand-knotted grain and per-tile pile lean
